items.title: Global Financial Stability Report flags increased liquidity mismatches among insurers
items.grounded_note: The IMF's October 2026 Global Financial Stability Report says liquidity mismatches among insurers and pension funds have increased. It also identifies sovereign-yield shocks, AI-related market corrections and cyber threats as potential triggers of wider market stress. This is a sector-wide risk signal relevant to insurers' asset-liability, liquidity and operational-risk oversight.

items.title: Taiwan sets updated nuclear-insurance reserve requirements
items.grounded_note: The FSC ordered property insurers writing nuclear insurance to maintain unearned-premium, special and claims reserves. The order specifies calculation and accounting treatment, including a special reserve equal to 50% of retained earned amounts for direct and assumed business, and took effect immediately.

items.title: AIA Malaysia temporarily suspends Fitbit connectivity during Google API migration
items.grounded_note: Official AIA operational notice stating that Fitbit connectivity with AIA Vitality became temporarily unavailable from 1 October 2026 because Google was replacing the Fitbit API with the Google Health API. During migration, Fitbit activity and sleep data cannot sync and members cannot earn associated Vitality points.
